advertisement_review.reason: The immutable public-state analytic oracle proves the advertised fluid-rope contact behavior on the physical Metal driver, the exact lifecycle contract passes, and current Metal agrees with current physical Vulkan. The failed broad trajectory comparison is retained as a historical CUDA-reference limitation and does not justify deleting a capability that passes its independent physical contract.

reproduction: Configure a clean Release build with PARALLEL_MATER_BUILD_CONFORMANCE=ON and PARALLEL_MATER_BUILD_SLANG_METAL_PREVIEW=ON.
Select the generated slang-metal and validation manifests with PM_DRIVER_FILES and PM_LAYER_FILES and set PM_TEST_VALIDATION=1.
Run parallel-mater-conformance --quality fluid-rope-contact-v1 and evaluate it with conformance/v1/quality.py.
Run parallel-mater-conformance --lifecycle-profile adverse-capacity-three-family-v1 and evaluate it with conformance/v1/lifecycle.py.
Run parallel-mater-conformance --case rope-fluid and compare it first with conformance/v1/golden/cuda, then diagnostically with the retained Android Pixel 7 Vulkan capture.
Run python3 conformance/v1/evidence_index.py --check, python3 conformance/v1/update_manifest.py --check and the focused Python conformance tests.
limitations: This evidence completes the exact qualification contract and physical oracle review; it does not claim that slang-metal passes the historical CUDA reference or that the exact capability is fully qualified in the merged index.
The CUDA golden predates the shared swept-mesh contact correction. Replacing it requires a separately reviewed current CUDA capture; neither the Metal nor Vulkan capture is promoted to a CUDA golden.
No tolerance, golden, capability tuple, physics equation or platform-specific schedule changed for this completion.
